subject: POC: MAP checklist & network credential handoff
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@medsys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC: MAP checklist & network credential handoff

Hi Aaron —

Nice speaking yesterday. Attaching the latest MAP extract (MAP_v0.3.pdf) and a compact network checklist we use for POC environments. To get the evaluation rolling, we need to lock the following items in the MAP this week so we can hit your end-of-June target: 

1) Org setup: create a dedicated MedSys org on Redwood and provide the primary org owner email.
2) API keys: request for a sandbox API key (scoped to evaluation model) + service account instructions for key rotation.
3) IP allowlist: one consolidated file with CIDR blocks for peering + static egress IPs.
4) VPC peering: desired VPC CIDR and peering window (we typically schedule peering in a 2-hour maintenance slot).

Action items I propose this week:
- Aaron: confirm org owner and identify infra contact for peering (by Tue).
- Infra: provide target CIDR / firewall contact (by Wed).
- Redwood (Laura + Vivek): we'll provision the eval org, generate sandbox keys, and share the secure upload link (by Fri).

I've attached network-checklist.xlsx with the exact fields we need for peering and allowlist. Laura — can you start the org creation and draft the service-account instruction doc? Vivek — once we have CIDRs, please prepare the peering runbook and schedule.

Thanks,

--
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: MAP_v0.3.pdf (PDF, 420KB); network-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 18KB)
From: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@medsys.com>

Date: 2026-05-25T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC: MAP checklist & network credential handoff

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the summary and the checklist. We're aligned on the overall MAP. A few clarifications from our side:

- Org owner: I'm assigning Maria Chen (maria.chen@medsys.com) as the owner.
- API keys: we'll need a sandbox API key with request quotas capped (estimate: 10K tokens/day to start). Are you able to provide a scoped key for that?
- IP allowlist: infra attached our current outbound ranges; see below. We'll also need the Redwood peer ASN and any specific subnet restrictions for the peering.
- VPC peering: our infra prefers a weekend window (Sat morning Pacific).

I've looped infra@medsys.com here; their contact is in case you need VPN details or a ticket.

On the attachments: I couldn't open the XLSX in my environment; could you also paste the required fields as plain text or a small ACL file?

Aaron
Director, Platform Engineering
MedSys Health
aaron.lee@medsys.com

Aaron —

Thanks. Yes, we can issue a scoped sandbox key with a 10K/day soft cap; the key will be rate-limited and tagged to the DEAL-8342 evaluation org. I've pasted the required network fields below for convenience, and attached a small ACL_allowlist.txt as requested.

Required network fields (paste into a ticket or reply):
- Redwood peer ASN: AS65021
- Redwood egress static IPs (for allowlist): 34.189.72.16/32, 34.189.72.17/32
- Expected peering: route-based VPC peering (we support AWS/GCP/Azure)
- Required ports: TCP 443 outbound for API; optional TCP 22 for maintenance (by request)

Next steps I will take now:
- Laura will create the MedSys evaluation org (Laura — please confirm org URL and provisional owner).
- I will generate the sandbox API key and upload to our secure link.
- Vivek will draft a peering runbook and propose Saturday, Jun 6 02:00–04:00 PT as a slot (open to adjustment).

Laura — can you also produce the short service-account-instructions.md so their infra can perform the key upload? I've attached a draft ACL_allowlist.txt.

Cheers,
Olga
